title: Church Discipline and Restoration
definition: Church Discipline and Restoration is the loving correction of sin in the Church for repentance, holiness, protection, and restoration.
summary: Church Discipline and Restoration is the biblical process of correcting serious sin with the aim of repentance, protection, and restoration.
christFocus: Jesus Christ loves His Church enough to correct, cleanse, and restore His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church discipline and restoration is the biblical process of addressing serious sin for the good of the sinner, the purity of the church, and the honor of Christ. Scripture presents discipline as painful but loving when done rightly.

Discipline is not punishment for embarrassment or a tool for control. Its aim is repentance, protection, truth, and restoration wherever possible.

Jesus is both holy Lord and restoring Shepherd. His church must take sin seriously while holding open the call to repentance and the hope of grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches often either ignore destructive sin or handle it harshly. Biblical discipline corrects both neglect and abuse by making restoration, holiness, and humility central.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not confuse love with silence when sin is destroying someone. Follow Scripture carefully, involve proper leadership, guard against pride, and seek repentance and restoration with tears rather than triumph.
